craft_notes: Sthāyin bhakti-plea. Comma→semicolon after 'grant': asking held, arrival released in line 2. Rejected: 'milk me' pun — profanes the drawn-out-milk image; dropped. Read aloud: grant waits, come comes.

reads_against.argmap: From māyā-water's belly fully drawn out, made stainless: Śiva-knowledge. → Beg Śiva-knowledge, milked stainless from māyā.
c1_essence: Milked stainless Śiva-wisdom begged; offering carried to undivided Bhava, ultimate truth's one being.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti-vismaya (devotion charged with wonder); sthayibhava utsāha-in-bhakti

l2.plain_english: From māyā's watery belly fully drawn out and made stainless — Śiva-knowledge, milked of itself: give, come, O Hara-goose, to us.
